meta_description: A hardware spotlight on Lioness, a startup in the hardware manufacturing space that designs and manufactures vibrators for women. It's been difficult for people to talk about this particular type of product for a long time, and there have been few best practices and lots of poorly designed models. In this Spotlight, we sit down with the three co-founders of Lioness to talk shop about innovating an intimacy device—with straight faces.
